remarks: An exceptional income producing-producing asset awaits, featuring two separate single-family homes on one lot, perfect for maximizing rental income or owner-occupancy with income. The front house offers 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, with a flexible layout featuring 2 bedrooms and a full bathroom on the first floor, and 2 additional bedrooms and another bathroom on the second floor; it also includes an updated kitchen and an attached 1-car garage. The newer rear house, built in 2015, boasts a modern layout with 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. Its main level features an updated kitchen and a large living room, while the second level includes a primary bedroom with an ensuite, three additional bedrooms, and another full bath. A finished third level provides a large rec room plus an additional room ideal for an office. This home is complete with a 2-car garage and a private patio that opens to the yard. This unique property provides flexibility, modern amenities in the newer construction, and incredible potential for investors seeking two distinct income streams.
